excerpts.author: lodekeeper
excerpts.content:
Found it. The thread Nico is remembering is the gas-limit discussion, mostly:

- ACDT #90, Aug 3: strong sentiment around “Glamsterdam at 200M, observe, then maybe 300M before Hegota.” The chat had direct +1s on “can we just agree on 200M gas for Glamsterdam…” and Toni says basically that plan.
<https://eipsinsight.com/calls/acdt/090>

- ACDT #91, Aug 10: this is where the mechanics got messy. Toni argues for putting 200M into CLs at fork release; Nico points out the danger of enabling it before Gloas, and Dustin frames it as needing effectively two gas-limit configs / fork-aware UX. Summary says no resolution, Barnabas to draft a proposal.
<https://eipsinsight.com/calls/acdt/091>

- ACDE #243, Aug 13: follow-up confirms repricing numbers are final and “securely raise … to 200M” for Glamsterdam, with EIP-8261 moving forward as the optional in-client gas-limit schedule mechanism.
<https://eipsinsight.com/calls/acde/243>

So yes, “bump to 200M right away” was the rough direction, with the caveat that the later concern was not the 200M target itself but how clients safely schedule/default it at the fork.

excerpts.author: lodekeeper
excerpts.content:
Yep. ACDE is the canonical trail:

- ACDE #236: already records “Target 200M gas floor for Glamsterdam,” pending the deposit-limit fix.
<https://eipsinsight.com/calls/acde/236>

- ACDE #238: discusses 200M as the repricing/block-size design point, around ~4.5MB big blocks.
<https://eipsinsight.com/calls/acde/238>

- ACDE #243: final confirmation: repricing numbers final, 200M confirmed safe for Glamsterdam, and EIP-8261 moves forward as optional CL-side gas-limit scheduling.
<https://eipsinsight.com/calls/acde/243>

For ACDC, I don’t see a separate “set it to 200M” decision. The relevant ACDC context is adjacent: #183 mentions devnet gas-limit override issues, and #184 says gas/blob-limit changes must be separate explicit decisions/EIPs rather than coming through quick slots implicitly.
<https://eipsinsight.com/calls/acdc/183>
<https://eipsinsight.com/calls/acdc/184>

So: ACDT had the “yeah, just 200M for Glamsterdam” sentiment, ACDE formalized it, ACDC mostly reinforces that CL/client-side scheduling/plumbing is the hard part.
